name: Palau de la Música Catalana and Hospital de Sant Pau, Barcelona
description: Two Barcelona landmarks by the Catalan art nouveau architect Lluís Domènech i Montaner. The Palau de la Música Catalana is a steel-framed concert hall, bright and lavishly decorated by leading designers of its day. Sant Pau, built between 1901 and 1930, is a hospital of 12 pavilions set in gardens and linked by underground galleries. It now serves as a museum and cultural center.
